How to Use & Tips - Page Numbers

1How to Use Page Numbers

  1. Upload the PDF document you want to number.
  2. Select the position and the number format (e.g., 'Page 1 of 10').
  3. Adjust the text size and color to match your document's style.
  4. Click 'Save & Download PDF' to apply the numbering.

2Professional & Security Tips

  • Avoid placing numbers in corners if your document has content there to prevent overlapping.
  • Standard formatting usually requires page numbers in the top-right or bottom-center.
  • Using the 'Page 1 of 10' format helps readers know exactly how long the document is.

What is Page Numbers?

The Page Numbers tool provides a simple way to organize your PDF documents by inserting sequential numbering across your pages. This is essential for navigating lengthy reports, academic essays, or legal manuscripts. You can easily select where the numbers appear, such as the top-right corner or the bottom-center, and customize the starting number to fit your formatting requirements.

100% Private & Secure

We process all document modifications locally within your web browser. When you add page numbers to your PDF, your data is never transmitted to our servers or exposed to third parties. You can format confidential business documents with absolute peace of mind knowing your files never leave your device.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Can I choose the position of the page numbers?
A: Yes, our tool offers multiple placement options, allowing you to position the numbers exactly where you need them on the page.

Q: Is it possible to start numbering from a page other than the first?
A: Currently, the tool adds sequential numbering to the entire document, but you can specify the starting digit if your document is a continuation of another file.
